DESCRIPTOR.LABEL: Functional Annotation of Animal Genomes (FAANG) sample checklist, mouse brain extension (Allen and UBERON brain regions, MGI genotype)
DESCRIPTOR.NAME: FAANG mouse brain sample checklist
DESCRIPTOR.DESCRIPTION: Minimum information required for Functional Annotation of Animal Genomes (FAANG) samples, extended with mouse line genotype (MGI) and brain region (Allen Brain Atlas and UBERON) fields

FIELD_GROUP.restrictionType: Any number or none of the fields
FIELD_GROUP.NAME: sample collection

FIELD.LABEL: Sample
FIELD.NAME: sample
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: A unique reference or identifier for the sample. Example: sample123

FIELD.LABEL: Organism
FIELD.NAME: organism
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: NCBI taxon ID of organism. Example: 9606

FIELD.LABEL: Health Status
FIELD.NAME: health_status
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Healthy animals should have the term normal, otherwise use the as many disease terms as necessary from EFO. Example: normal

FIELD.LABEL: Sex
FIELD.NAME: sex
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Sex of the organism from which the sample was obtained. It can be described in any child term of PATO_0000047. Example: female

FIELD.LABEL: Birth Date
FIELD.NAME: birth_date
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Birth date, in the format YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM where only the month is known. For embryo samples record 'not applicable'. Example: 2025-01-24

FIELD.LABEL: Breed
FIELD.NAME: breed
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Animal breed, described using the FAANG breed description guidelines (http://bit.ly/FAANGbreed). Should be considered mandatory for terrestiral species, for aquatic species record 'not applicable'. Example: Large Black

FIELD.LABEL: Specimen Collection Date
FIELD.NAME: collection date
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The date the sample was collected either as an instance (single point in time) or interval. In case no exact time is available, the date/time can be right truncated i.e. all of these are valid ISO8601 compliant times: 2008-01-23T19:23:10+00:00; 2008-01-23T19:23:10; 2008-01-23; 2008-01; 2008. Example: 2024-01-19

FIELD.LABEL: Geographic Location
FIELD.NAME: geographic location (country and/or sea)
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The geographical origin of where the sample was collected from as defined by the country or sea name. Country or sea names should be chosen from the INSDC country list (http://insdc.org/country.html). Example: Algeria

TEXT_VALUE.VALUE: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

FIELD.LABEL: Animal Age At Collection
FIELD.NAME: animal_age_at_collection
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The age of the animal at the time of collection. If the exact age is not known, an estimate is acceptable. The age should be represented in the format: years, weeks, days, with each part being optional and specified in that order (e.g., "2 years 5 weeks 3 days" or "35 days"). Example: 2 years 5 weeks 3 days

FIELD.LABEL: Developmental Stage
FIELD.NAME: dev_stage
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: If the sample was obtained from an organism in a specific developmental stage, it is specified with this qualifier. The ontology for Developmental stage, UBERON, is preferred to EFO. Example: juvenile stage

FIELD.LABEL: organism part
FIELD.NAME: organism part
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The part of organism's anatomy or substance arising from an organism from which the biomaterial was derived, excludes cells. UBERON is the ontology preferred to BTO. Example: neuronal cell body

FIELD.LABEL: Specimen Collection Protocol
FIELD.NAME: collection_protocol
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: A link to the protocol for specimen collection. Example: https://data.faang.org/api/fire_api/samples/WU_SOP_GENESWITCH_PIGLET_AND_FETUS_D70_SAMPLING_20210907.pdf

FIELD.LABEL: Derived From
FIELD.NAME: derived_from
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Sample name or BioSample ID for an animal record. Example: SAMEA112465628

FIELD_GROUP.restrictionType: Any number or none of the fields
FIELD_GROUP.NAME: mouse genotype and brain region

FIELD.LABEL: Genotype Mouse Line
FIELD.NAME: genotype_mouse_line
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The genotype of the mouse line the sample was derived from, given in standard JAX/MGI strain nomenclature, or the line's established common name. For wild-type animals record the background strain. Example: B6.Cg-Tg(APPSwFlLon,PSEN1*M146L*L286V)6799Vas/Mmjax

FIELD.LABEL: MGI ID Genotype
FIELD.NAME: mgi_id_genotype
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The MGI strain accession identifying the line recorded in Genotype Mouse Line. Format MGI:nnnnnnn. Example: MGI:3811801 (5XFAD). For a wild-type C57BL/6J animal this is MGI:3028467.

FIELD.LABEL: Brain Region Allen ID
FIELD.NAME: brain_region_allen_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The Allen Brain Atlas structure identifier (integer) for the brain region the sample was dissected from. Must be an ID from the Allen mouse brain reference ontology. Example: 1089

FIELD.LABEL: Brain Region Allen Acronym
FIELD.NAME: brain_region_allen_acronym
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The Allen Brain Atlas structure acronym corresponding to Brain Region Allen ID. Must match the acronym of that structure exactly. Example: HPF

FIELD.LABEL: Brain Region UBERON ID
FIELD.NAME: brain_region_uberon_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The UBERON identifier for the brain region the sample was dissected from, as a CURIE. Must be a term at or below UBERON:0001017 (central nervous system). Example: UBERON:0001954

FIELD.LABEL: Brain Region UBERON Name
FIELD.NAME: brain_region_uberon_name
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: The UBERON term label corresponding to Brain Region UBERON ID. Must match the label of that term exactly. Example: Ammon's horn
